market.question: Will Core CPI MoM be 0.2% in May?

en.title: Core CPI MoM 0.2% Probability Rises
en.summary: The probability of May Core CPI MoM being 0.2% increased to 54% (+3.5%), driven by growing market anticipation of specific core inflation moderation ahead of Wednesday's official report. Traders are positioning for a notable deceleration in underlying price pressures.
drivers: Growing anticipation of core inflation moderation
Pre-report positioning ahead of May CPI release
Belief in divergence from headline CPI expectations
en.why_matters: A 0.2% Core CPI MoM reading would signal significant disinflation, heavily influencing the Federal Reserve's interest rate decisions.
en.bull_case: Stronger-than-expected deceleration in services ex-shelter or used car prices could push Core CPI MoM to 0.2%.
en.bear_case: Persistent strength in shelter inflation or unexpected increases in other core components could keep Core CPI MoM above 0.2%.

zh.title: 核心CPI月率0.2%概率上升
zh.summary: 5月核心CPI月率达到0.2%的概率升至54%（+3.5%），主要受市场对核心通胀将具体放缓的预期增强所驱动，交易员正在为周三官方报告前的潜在价格压力减速进行布局。
drivers: 核心通胀放缓预期增强
5月CPI报告发布前的市场仓位调整
市场预期核心与整体CPI将分化
zh.why_matters: 0.2%的核心CPI月率将预示显著的通货紧缩，对美联储的利率决策产生重大影响。
zh.bull_case: 服务业（不含住房）或二手车价格超预期减速，可能使核心CPI月率降至0.2%。
zh.bear_case: 住房通胀持续坚挺或核心商品/服务意外涨价，可能使核心CPI月率高于0.2%。
